caseName: Esenwein v. Commonwealth ex rel. Esenwein
caseNameFull: Esenwein v. Commonwealth ex rel. Esenwein
attorneys: Mr. Sidney J. Watts for petitioner. Mr. J. Thomas Hoffman for respondent.

opinions.text: The order of March 6, 1944, denying certiorari, 321U. S. 782, is vacated, and the petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania is granted.
